name: Cooling-system Sealer

features.text: Helps seal radiator, gaskets and freeze plugs.
Compatible with all types of coolant.

description: MOC® Cooling System Sealer is designed to seal leaks caused by cracks or holes in the radiator, block and head gasket. It has the unique ability to seal leaks by forming a "scab" over the hole or damaged area. This nonmetallic formula is safe to use with all types of antifreeze and coolants. This non-clogging product may be used in all pressurized systems and will not harm plastic, metal or rubber parts.
application: Add directly to radiator after coolant/water mixture has been added. Do not add through flush machines. Run MOC® Cooling System Sealer through entire system. If MOC® Cooling System Sealer does not help stop a leak, this may be a sign of more serious cooling-system problems that should be addressed.
